description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access and manipulate PerformanceTrackerLog entities, including fetching formatted dates and setting associated entities like Employee, User, and PerformanceTracker by their IDs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for PerformanceTrackerLog entity, providing utility methods for date formatting and setting related entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTrackerLog entity.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the log was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the log was last modified.

methods.name: setReviewerByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated as reviewer by their employee number.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the associated user by their user ID.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerById
methods.description: Sets the associated PerformanceTracker by its ID.
